title: Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra vs MikroTik hEX S for a bootstrapped SaaS team planning a three-year deployment: technical buying guide
meta_description: Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra vs MikroTik hEX S: official specifications, compatibility, deployment fit, and operational requirements.
intro: This source-backed comparison evaluates Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra and MikroTik hEX S for a bootstrapped SaaS team planning a three-year deployment. It focuses on stable technical characteristics, deployment fit, interfaces, form factor, and operational trade-offs. It does not copy volatile prices, stock, star ratings, or unverified user claims.
verdict: Choose Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra when small unifi deployments wanting an integrated controller and gateway is the leading requirement. Choose MikroTik hEX S when technical users valuing granular routing configuration matters more. For a bootstrapped SaaS team planning a three-year deployment, verify compatibility, support, current availability, and workload limits in the cited manufacturer documentation before purchase.
